# Ceramiche Artistiche Bressan C2

> Italian artisan workshop in Pianezze, Vicenza, creating hand-painted artistic ceramics for shops, boutiques and points of sale.

This website is a visual catalogue, not an ecommerce store. It does not offer online checkout or direct sales to the public from the production workshop.

## Main pages

* [Company](/en/company): Workshop, location and company details.
* [Creations](/en/creations): Main decorative and product families.
* [Catalog](/en/catalog): Photographic catalogue organized by theme.
* [For retailers](/en/retailers): Information for shops and points of sale.
* [Workmanship](/en/workmanship): Hand decoration and artisan production.
* [Contact](/en/contact): Business enquiries and workshop location.
